what_happened.line: The Economic Development Committee took up a motion not to support a separate stormwater utility; the minutes record it moved and seconded, but the vote was not audible.
Members discussed how stormwater charges on businesses could be passed on to tenants and customers, and one suggested phasing in funding within the town budget instead of a new fee.
A motion to reach out to the state delegation about the liquor license process was made and seconded; the outcome was not audible, and a member will email the delegation.
The director reported planning board bylaw changes on parking and change of use, which were informational only.
The committee left its meeting day flexible, with a recurring date to be set after checking the town schedule; Mondays at 5:30 were discussed.

why_it_matters: A separate stormwater utility would add a new charge for property owners, including businesses, and the committee's position and the alternative of funding it inside the town budget, mostly taxes, bear on who pays.
The liquor license outreach and the parking and change-of-use bylaw changes touch how easily local businesses can open or change use.
